mapper.select: SELECT tt.id AS ticketTypeId, tt.show_id AS showId, tt.name AS ticketTypeName, tt.price AS price, tt.sale_start_time AS saleStartTime, IFNULL(tt.left_stock, 0) AS leftStock, IFNULL(tt.total_stock, 0) AS totalStock, s.performance_id AS performanceId, s.start_time AS showStartTime, COALESCE(p.title, s.title) AS title, COALESCE(p.artist_name, s.artist) AS artist, COALESCE(p.want_count, 0) AS wantCount, v.name AS venueName, v.city AS city, COALESCE(p.poster, s.image) AS cover FROM tb_ticket_type tt INNER JOIN tb_show s ON s.id = tt.show_id INNER JOIN tb_performance p ON p.id = s.performance_id INNER JOIN tb_venue v ON v.id = s.venue_id WHERE tt.status = 1 AND p.status = 2 AND s.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND s.start_time > NOW() AND tt.sale_start_time > NOW() AND tt.sale_end_time >= NOW() AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), tt.sale_start_time) <= 86400
